entries.title: check_gate_log.py splits table cells on an escaped pipe
entries.defect: A Notes cell containing an escaped pipe is split into two cells, so the row is read with one column too many and rejected.

evidence.output: [FAIL] SPRINT_LOG.md: gate row has 7 cells, expected 6

entries.proposed_change: Split cells with the escaped-pipe-aware separator already used by check_task_scope.py.
